reference_execution_environment.rule: Record the observed macOS training environment separately from the validated Windows reproduction environment. Direct-load first; only amendment A9 permits the exact inference-only stable-UBJSON-Model recovery after the audited error. Never resume training from that recovery or ignore any warning except the one exact acknowledged joblib/NumPy deprecation.

hash_contract.authoritative_exchange: CSV; read with pandas float_precision='round_trip'. Excel must reproduce canonical_input_string_10dp before hash checks.

normalisation.input: frozen legacy-3000 min-max; joint input block divided by sqrt(8)
normalisation.objective: cost orientation [-CU, SEC, CAPEX]; frozen current-round predicted-front ideal/nadir; objective block divided by sqrt(3)

scores.local_error_knn: 5-NN inverse-distance mean of range-normalised absolute PREQUERY residuals from labelled local cases
scores.committee_disagreement: RMS across target ensemble SD divided by fixed target ranges

active_learning.near_front_pool: non-front rows at or below the 8th percentile of positive normalised objective distance to the current predicted front

greedy_rule.prefilter: top 5,000 eligible rows by stratum priority; candidate_id ascending resolves exact score ties
greedy_rule.selection: argmax utility; update minimum joint distance after every selection

forbidden: all post-freeze confirmation points once issued

iterative_stop.evidence: STOP_30 plus legacy-holdout global guardrail only; STOP_30 is not independent validation and is not final conformal calibration evidence

round_hypervolume_contract.outside_reference_rule: If either compared predicted front has a normalised coordinate >=2.0, expand the affected common coordinate to max(2.0,1.05*maximum_union_coordinate+0.01) and log the fallback.

conditions.no_STOP_target_NRMSE_deterioration_pp: no target may worsen by >0.2 percentage point in either of the two qualifying rounds
conditions.legacy_holdout_guardrail: no target worsens >10% relative OR >0.5 percentage point; apply stricter bound

iterative_stop.success_floor: Plateau is not success unless every target post-freeze-confirmation local-range NRMSE is <=5%; before lockbox opening use STOP only as a development estimate.

required: V29 learner protocol pooled with provenance-approved existing60
pooled update with all converged AL development labels
V29 frozen global predictor plus gated local residual correction

gated_local_residual.residual_features: 8 frozen-minmax inputs plus 3 V29 predicted targets
gated_local_residual.gate: g(x)=exp(-(d_knn(x)/tau)^2), with d_knn the 5-NN mean distance to local labelled development in frozen 8D input space
gated_local_residual.tau_selection: source/cluster-grouped development CV, then STOP_30; subject to legacy global guardrail; ties choose smaller tau
gated_local_residual.prediction: f_final=f_V29+g*h; clip only to predeclared physical target support

model_variants.selection_order: lowest mean fixed-range RMSE across three STOP targets subject to all global guardrails; ties within 1% choose the simpler/frozen-global variant

conformal.method: 5-fold source/cluster-grouped cross-conformal scaled by ensemble SD on permitted development only
conformal.evaluation: empirical coverage and width on fixed-region60, global40 and post-freeze confirmation96; report exact binomial CI

postfreeze_confirmation96.timing: after final model/archive/MCDM/analysis freeze and before any confirmation label
postfreeze_confirmation96.eligibility: all 96 metric rows must be previously unlabelled and hash-disjoint from legacy3000, existing60, STOP, fixed-region60, global40 and every AL round
postfreeze_confirmation96.forced_members: Use TOPSIS, VIKOR, Max CU, Min SEC and Min CAPEX as metric rows only when previously unlabelled. A previously labelled anchor is reported separately and its metric slot is replaced by a new unlabelled nearest-front design.
postfreeze_confirmation96.rank_universe: all converged confirmation96 candidate IDs, including dominated rows, using equal 1/3 weights and VIKOR v=0.5; actual nondominated status is a separate metric
postfreeze_confirmation96.top10_overlap_universe: the same all-converged confirmation96 IDs, predicted versus actual ranking; failed rows remain reported and are not silently removed
postfreeze_confirmation96.dominance_pairs: for each of 24 challengers, pair to its nearest selected V30-front point in frozen normalised objective space and materialise the pair before labels

hypervolume.normalisation: frozen V30 predicted-front ideal/nadir, materialised before labels
hypervolume.outside_reference_rule: Never clip. If any predicted or actual normalised coordinate is >=2.0, replace each affected common reference coordinate by max(2.0,1.05*maximum_union_coordinate+0.01), apply the same expanded point to both predicted and actual sets, and explicitly report that the predeclared fallback was triggered.
hypervolume.comparison: predicted versus actual nondominated subsets of the same issued confirmation96 candidate universe
